Swallowed gum stays in you for seven years, right? 🤔 Nope — it's out in a few days. Your body can't digest gum, but it keeps it moving. 🦜🐶

Animated cartoon. Voices are synthetic (AI text-to-speech).

Swallow a watermelon seed and a watermelon grows in your tummy? 🍉😄 Nope, nothing happens — no sunlight or soil inside you, so a seed can't sprout. 🦜🐶

Animated cartoon. Voices are synthetic (AI text-to-speech).

The five-second rule keeps dropped food clean? ⏱️ Sorry — germs jump on the instant it lands. Bacteria stick on contact, and a damp snack picks up even more. 🦜🐶
